text_bounds.line: He led them behind the bridge.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Hana folded her big fin close and took her time.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.line: Slow tails. Small turns.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Nari listened at each turn. This time she spoke clearly.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.line: Left here!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Roshan followed. Little things made a useful path.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: That crate can slide sideways.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.line: There's a clear ledge for the props. I use it for parcels.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Rumi checked the banner loop. Hana found a place to push. Nari tested the other end.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.line: Ready when you are.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: We can fix it. First, let's ask.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: They swam up to the shell stage together.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: Your crates trapped Duri. And they're blocking the city's song. Will you move them?

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.line: Our show needs enormous props!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: He puffed out his glittery jacket.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.line: It needs neighbours too. There's room for your show and everyone else's voices.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: The farthest terraces stayed quiet.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: We'll put the scenery safely at the side.

text_bounds.speaker: Magician Imp
text_bounds.line: Nobody touches our spectacular scenery!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: POOF! Bubbles poured between Roshan and the gate. She paused instead of pushing through.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: The performer lifted a soft foam star. Hana caught a corner of the banner.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.line: Now we need our big moves.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Rumi took the first note. Hana swept into a bright dance. The trio turned together.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: I'll get to the crate!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: She slipped along the stage edge, looking for the current.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Nari tapped the shell drum.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.line: Keep the beat with me. We'll keep the way clear!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: The bubble cloud hid the gate. Roshan stopped and watched the little blue thread of water.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Nari left one drumbeat quiet and listened.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.line: The water is moving through the bottom!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Roshan ducked beneath the bubbles. Above her, Rumi spun clear of another puff.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.line: Little voice, big blue sea!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: WHOOSH! Hana caught the foam star in the soft banner. Nari bounced it gently back.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.line: Your star, coming home!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: The performer tumbled onto his padded cushions.

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.line: Oof! A very soft landing!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: The magician's next puff spun his hat backwards. BUMP! He landed beside his friend.

text_bounds.speaker: Hana
text_bounds.line: Big moves. Soft finish.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Rumi and Nari slid the two small crates onto the side ledge. Hana steadied them. One large crate remained.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Roshan looped the banner through its handle. She pulled. The crate moved a little, then stopped.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: I need you!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Duri checked the clear space. Her friends came to take their places.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: Hana, push. Rumi, with me. Nari, count.

text_bounds.speaker: Nari
text_bounds.line: One. Two. Gently!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: The last crate slid clear.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Duri swam through the open arch. A bright blue ribbon of current curled after him. All three crates stayed at the side.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: There!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: The ribbons stirred above the stage. The magic had been there all along.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: The current reached the shops. Duri tapped at a window. One little voice answered. Then another.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: He hurried past the bathhouse. Its neighbours hummed the familiar tune. The bridge ribbons fluttered.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: At the tram, more voices joined in. Duri's delivery was a song this time.

text_bounds.speaker: Duri
text_bounds.line: Everyone, there's room for you!

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: The imps moved their scenery into tidy stacks, leaving the current clear.

text_bounds.speaker: Performer Imp
text_bounds.line: Nobody sang with our show.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: You blocked their song.

text_bounds.speaker: Magician Imp
text_bounds.line: We didn't mean to trap you, Duri. Can we help now?

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: Leave everyone a space.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Rumi, Hana and Nari sang. Roshan joined them. The city answered, from the shops to the tram.

text_bounds.speaker: Everyone
text_bounds.line:
Little voice, big blue sea.
Sing with you, sing with me.

text_bounds.speaker: Everyone
text_bounds.line:
Make a space and let it through.
There's a place for me and you.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Roshan heard every voice.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: At last, Roshan and Rumi swam home. The seahorse fountain splashed, and the familiar rainbow turned.

text_bounds.speaker: Roshan
text_bounds.line: We haven't found the candle yet.

text_bounds.speaker: Rumi
text_bounds.line: No. But today, you heard a friend.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line: Far below came a little goodnight. Tap. Tap. Tap.

text_bounds.speaker: Narrator
text_bounds.line:
A little voice.
A whole city listening.

Tap. Tap. Tap.
